command: async (page) => { const response = page.waitForResponse(r=>r.url().includes("/api/actions/") && r.request().method()==="POST"); await page.getByRole("button",{name:"Film the practice-room grind",exact:true}).click(); const r=await response; return {url:r.url(),status:r.status(),body:await r.text(),request:r.request().postData()}; }
